about: THE VALLEY ROAD (route R6, One World BUILD_PLAN phase 4.2, 2026-11-17): a dirt road from the Woods' Tunnel Way (Dead Man's Cave, in the Clearing's room) south and east down the Tiber's valley to Disaster City's west side. Its own room: the Clearing's room is full (rule 5) and two zones never join. The map's band also reaches five plots west of the Tunnel Way; the road runs a spur out there to the water mill. The design page: 'down the Tiber valley past the water mill and over the covered bridge to the city'. The city end is the link valley_city (the city's free door just inside its west wall), so no seam door is written there.
